def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item

    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    scores[valid_mask] = -((bins[valid_mask] - item) // item)
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    remaining = bins[valid_mask] - item
    scores[valid_mask] = item / remaining if np.any(remaining > 0) else np.inf
    return scores

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    scores = np.full_like(bins, -np.inf)
    valid_mask = bins >= item
    k = np.floor_divide(bins[valid_mask], item)
    remainder = bins[valid_mask] % item
    scores[valid_mask] = k * 1000 - remainder
    return scores

algorithm: {This priority algorithm assigns the highest priority to bins that can fit the item (bin capacity ≥ item size) with the smallest remaining capacity after insertion, and the lowest priority (negative infinity) to bins that are too small to hold the item.}

def priority(item: float, bins: np.ndarray) -> np.ndarray:
    """Returns priority with which we want to add item to each bin.
    Args:
        item: Size of item to be added to the bin.
        bins: Array of capacities for each bin.
    Return:
        Array of same size as bins with priority score of each bin.
    """
    return np.where(bins >= item, -(bins - item), -np.inf)
